headline: Obama order freezes U.S.-held property of North Korea's government and ruling party and bans certain dealings with North Korea.
what_it_does: This executive order blocks, or freezes, any property and interests in property of the North Korean government and the Workers' Party of Korea that come under U.S. control. It also bans certain kinds of transactions involving North Korea. The title does not list which transactions are banned, so the details are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: The North Korean government and the Workers' Party of Korea
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets that fall under U.S. control are frozen and cannot be used or moved.
They are barred from certain transactions involving North Korea and must not deal in the frozen property.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 15, 2016; exact effective date not stated in the source provided.
